name: GEO Security Suite
author: GEO Block

sections.description:
Take control of your WordPress site’s security with GEO Security Suite, a feature-packed plugin designed to protect your website from spam, brute force attacks, and unauthorized access. With an intuitive interface and powerful functionality, this plugin is perfect for users looking to secure their site without complex setups.

Why GEO Security Suite?

This plugin lets you restrict access to your website’s content and admin area based on geolocation or IP address. Whether you want to block specific countries or allow access only to a select few, GEO Security Suite makes it easy.

Who can benefit?

  • Businesses with geo-restricted content.
  • Bloggers wanting to reduce spam from certain regions.
  • Admins concerned about brute force login attempts.
  • Developers prioritizing server efficiency by blocking malicious traffic.

Key Features

  • Country-Level Blocking: Prevent access from unwanted countries in just one click.
  • IP Blocking: Ban specific IPs responsible for malicious activity or spam.
  • Login Page Protection: Secure your backend from brute force password attacks.
  • Customizable Allowlist (Whitelist): Block entire countries but allow exceptions for trusted users.
  • Comprehensive Analytics: Get detailed stats and graphs showing blocked traffic (daily, weekly, monthly).
  • User-Friendly: Quick setup with no technical expertise required.
  • Free Support: Enjoy peace of mind with free help whenever you need it.

Added Benefits:
Stop common vulnerabilities in their tracks and keep your WordPress admin area secure against growing threats. GEO Security Suite provides a robust layer of defense against the most frequent attacks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload all the files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
